title: SocialDial: A Benchmark for Socially-Aware Dialogue Systems
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It was designed to measure adherence to secular social norms (e.g., politeness, requests, apologies) within Chinese cultural contexts in multi-turn dialogues.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
